sonar.passive_nm.BOW.sea1.own12.d150.reason: Phase 4: ray-traced propagation (Snell rays, lossy Rayleigh bottom, rough surface) replaces the fixed 6.5 dB layer penalty. In ~800 m of water over sand bottom-bounce and multipath fill the region below the layer beyond ~10 NM, so cross-layer ranges roughly double; the shadow zone remains at short range and in deep water.

sonar.passive_nm.BOW.sea1.own18.d150.reason: Deep sound channel: the ray-traced profile now continues the temperature profile to the seabed instead of a linear pressure gradient below 400 m, so an interior sound-speed minimum (~500 m) refracts deep rays back up and slightly raises levels below the layer; this self-noise-limited cavitating case gains about 10 %.
